title: A user's accepted rooms are Chat.privateMetadata (metadata-05) in namespace mimid.reviewcommit.com
description:
Bead mimid-f2rn (decided by Mark 2026-11-19: a new device joins by external Commit only rooms the user accepted). Where the acceptance lives, so every device of the user sees it.

Readings:
(a) An INVENTED Chat property in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (e.g. Chat.accepted). Needs a spec change in jmap-chat-spec.
(b) A Consent record (mimi-00 §Consent) with roomId scope and decision "grant" towards the inviter. Consent is about KeyPackage handout; a grant is sent to the inviter's provider, and a room the user created has no inviter. Wrong meaning, side effects.
(c) Room/unbind of declined rooms. Records declines, not acceptance: a pending invite stays bound and would still be joined.
(d) Chat.privateMetadata of draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-05, which draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Chat (note after the field list) names: "Implementations MAY include Chat in that map". It is per user, synced through the user's server, read with Chat/get and written with Chat/set, and needs no new spec text; only the namespace and its content are mimid's.

Chosen: (d).

Details:
1. mimid-server lists Chat in the account's urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata dataTypes: namespaces [], supportsVendorNamespaces true, supportsPrivate true, maxDepth 4 (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC: the value). Shared `metadata` is always {} and a write to it is `forbidden` (decision below, item 2).
2. Shared Chat `metadata` is not writable: every Chat here is roomed, and mimi-00 §Chat.roomId makes a roomed Chat's shared state MLS group state and refuses Chat/set of its name, description and members with `forbidden`. metadata-05 §4.1 lets the server withhold maySetMetadata; with no rights object it is "the account is not read-only", so this is a narrowing: INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC.
3. Quota (metadata-05 §3.2.1 SHOULD): at most MAX_CHAT_PRIVATE_METADATA_LEN (16384) octets of JSON per Chat, else overQuota. INVENTED value.
4. Chat state gains a fourth part, the highest privateMetadata write sequence of the account's Chats ("s.m.d.p"); old three-part states get cannotCalculateChanges.
5. The namespace is "mimid.reviewcommit.com" (a domain Mark controls, metadata-05 §2.1), INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC. Its content: {"accepted": true}.
6. Who writes it: a device of the user that is an active member of a room records it accepted (Agent::join_own_rooms, at each sync): accepting a Welcome (Agent::join, by the bridge's InvitePolicy or the user), creating a room (host_room) and joining by external Commit all make a device a member. Agent::leave clears it, and so does a device that processes its own removal (it is queued and cleared at the next join_own_rooms); another still-active device sets it again, so a device removed alone (e.g. for lacking AppDataUpdate) does not withdraw the user's acceptance.
7. Migration: none on the server. Rooms accepted before this change are marked by the first upgraded device that is still in them. A Chat existing on the server is NOT taken as acceptance, since a Welcome creates the Chat whether or not any device accepts it.
8. A server without the metadata capability for Chat: join_own_rooms joins nothing (fails closed) and says so in its outcome.
